candidate_selection.target_coverage_priority: prefer assignments measured in more target contexts; retain per-context count variation
candidate_selection.training: greedy complete-directive Hamming diversity with hash tie-breaks; QoR-blind
candidate_selection.validation: highest target-support assignments, then hash tie-break; QoR-blind

selection_rationale: Label-independent coverage screen using authenticated training-side graph/action inventory, per-target valid measurement counts, exact assignment support across six device/clock contexts, and structural diversity including loop-only and multiple array-action kernels. Validation QoR was not used.
